name: Maxwell Frost
bio: a Representative from Florida; born in Orlando, Orange County, Fla., January 17, 1997; graduated from Osceola County School for the Arts, Kissimmee, Fla.; attended the Valencia College, Orlando, Fla.; campaign staff; organizer; rideshare driver; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Eighteenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2023–present).
